question.text: Let $P Q R$ be a triangle such that $\overrightarrow{P Q}=-2 \hat{i}-\hat{j}+2 \hat{k}$ and $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PR}}=a \hat{\mathrm{i}}+b \hat{\mathrm{j}}-4 \hat{\mathrm{k}}, a, b \in \mathbb{Z}$. Let S be the point on QR, which is equidistant from the lines PQ and PR. If $|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PR}}|=9$ and $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PS}}=\hat{\mathrm{i}}-7 \hat{\mathrm{j}}+2 \hat{\mathrm{k}}$, then the value of $3 a-4 b$ is $\_\_\_\_$
